{{Top|leg}}
'''Hypergems''' were incredibly rare and valuable aperiodic [[diamondoid]]s that were formed in the cores of [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron stars]].

==Effects on sentients==
Hypergems had crystalline planar networks that extended into higher dimensions. Attempting to take in the multidimensional lattice with a [[Brain/Legends|brain]] that was accustomed to only three spatial dimensions and one temporal could cause some [[Species/Legends|species]] to go insane, while others found the gem to be something of unsurpassed beauty and would starve to death simply staring at it. The [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] were a species known to be resistant to most of the hypergem's mental effects, and [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] was rumored to stare at a hypergem and then tear himself away from it just to test his willpower.
